output.headline: The buyer universes share only Blackstone and TPG Capital, and sponsors clear their target return at the ask for Health IT but not for Dental.
sentences: The lists overlap on just Blackstone and TPG Capital, with Blackstone rated High conviction for both targets. [Q:shared]
TPG Capital is Medium for Health IT because its median deal of $88M is under half the $300M EV, a concern that does not apply to Dental, where it is High. [Q:shared]

Health IT adds strategics Evolent Health and Epic Systems at High conviction, while Dental adds strategics Heartland Dental and Aspen Dental (ADMI) alongside High-conviction sponsors Hellman & Friedman, General Atlantic and Welsh Carson. [Q:only_a, Q:only_b]

Health IT supports a defensible 21.4x and sponsors clear their target return at the ask; Dental's defensible 15.4x is higher in percentile terms, yet sponsors do not clear their target return at the ask. [Q:target_a, Q:target_b]
